Name: (CP) Druid Linus
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=5]Updated for 1.6, with new winter variant![/size]


[size=3]After first run, go into the generated config.json and choose your combination of robe and leaf crown from there, with winter robe and winter crown as their own values.[/size]

Ever noticed on the official wiki that the Wizard is Linus' only confirmed friend? Or maybe you've seen how the two stand over the cave in the Spirit's Eve together, watching the mortal fools wander in the maze. After finding [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/wizard-and-linus-at-spirits-eve.113782/]this thread [/url]speculating if Linus is actually a wizard or druid after finding Linus' quote to him ("Good show, old friend"), I'm all for that theory, so I made sprites to match~ I kept the design on the simpler end, given that he has simpler tastes in dress.



[b]To install--[/b]
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. After first run, go into the generated config.json (can be opened using [url=https://notepad-plus-plus.org/]Notepad++[/url] or program of your choice) to choose your desired combination (default is Robe: True, Crown: True, Winter Robes: True, Winter Crown: True). Alternatively, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to make your choice in-game.﻿
4. Load up your game and enjoy!




--
[b]To install XNB version (1.5 and under; under optional files)--[/b]
1. [b]Backup your original files![/b]
2. Unzip the file with your program of choice
3. Choose which Linus style you want--Leafy Crown and Robe, Leafy Crown Only, or Robe Only
4. Copy and paste the XNB files into its corresponding folder 
"Characters" Linus.xnb into Content > Characters
"Portraits" Linus.xnb into Content > Portraits
5. Load up your game and enjoy! 


[size=3]Original Content Patcher version, thanks to [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/49510578]cerreli[/url][size=3]![/size]
